items.descZh: 该数据集基于开源与开放科学理念，旨在构建一个富含深度哲学与神学注释的《摩诃婆罗多》角色结构化知识库。核心功能包含307个史诗角色的多维属性标注，涵盖身份、谱系、武器、超凡力量、生平大事及道德困境等字段。其突出亮点在于引入了高度量化的伦理与能力指标，例如角色的“正法完整性”（分值区间10-100）、“武力主导值”（分值区间10-100）以及“宇宙影响力指数”（分值区间31-99），并将三德（Sattva、Rajas、Tamas）概率进行了精细化预测（如Krishna的Sattva概率高达0.98，置信度达0.93）。此外，数据集还量化了角色的悲剧缺陷（置信度0.78）与正法灵活性（分值范围0.1至4），实现了对复杂神学概念的数字化建模。该数据集非常适用于训练具备深层文化背景、道德推理能力的AI模型，特别是在计算神话学、伦理学研究及跨文化大模型应用开发中具有重要价值。
items.quote: 我们正致力于通过开源和开放科学，推进和民主化人工智能。

items.title: Show HN: GrowSpot – checks if a plant can live in an exact spot, not just a room
items.desc: description: A room isn&39;t one light level: 20,000 lux at the window, 18 in the corner of the same room. Check the spot your plant will actually stand in. Free, no signup. title: Is my room bright enough for plants? Free spot checker GrowSpot image: https://growspotapp.com/assets/og/spotchecker.jpg Free web tool · no signup Will this plant live in that spot? We trade 90 days of Plus for honest feedback.GrowSpot Plus is free for 90 days on iPhone and Android. What we want back is what your own plants in your own spots tell you, including the parts of the app that annoy you.[Get 90 days free](/founding/) Is my room bright enough for plants? It’s the right worry and the wrong unit. A room doesn’t have one brightness. It has a gradient, and the gradient is far steeper than your eyes report. On a clear day around midday I measured every spot in one ordinary living room where a plant could plausibly live: same hour, sensor facing up, roughly plant height, using a phone as a rough light meter. Spot Reading At the bright window 20,000 lux 1 m from the window 15,000 lux 2–3 m away, in window shade 3,500 lux Middle of the room 570 lux Darker side of the room 119 lux The dark corner 18 lux Same room, same minute. The window reads roughly a thousand times the corner. Which is why “is my room bright enough” has no answer, and “is this spot bright enough” does. _One room, six readings — a single sample, not a study, and your numbers will be different. The size of the gap is what to take away, not the exact figures._ Full writeup: [I measured 6 spots in one living room](/guides/howbrightisthemiddleofaroom/). What counts as “bright enough”? It depends on the plant, and that isn’t a dodge: it’s the whole problem. A windowsill that keeps a jade plant happy will scorch a calathea. “Bright enough” is a range that belongs to the plant, not a line that belongs to the room, which is why the checker above asks which plant before it asks anything else. Light is also only one of four things that decide whether a spot works. Temperature, humidity and airflow decide it too, and they shift from spot to spot inside one room. A bathroom shelf and a hallway shelf can be one wall apart and two different climates. What this checker can’t tell you It works from what you describe plus the weather where you are, so what it gives back is an estimate, and it’s labeled as one on the result. It doesn’t know what that spot does in winter. It can’t replace a reading taken in the spot itself. The rest of the list lives on its own page, including the two that surprise people most — the compass sets airflow and not light, and a grow light is invisible to a daylight estimate: [what this checker can’t tell you](/limits/). Measure the spot instead of describing it This page works from a description. The app works from the spot: set the phone down where the plant will actually stand, and it reads light, temperature, humidity and airflow at that point, then tells you plainly whether the plant in your hands belongs there. Yes, there’s a builtin light meter. It’s one of the four readings, not the whole answer. Questions people ask How can I tell if a plant is getting enough light? The plant says so before a meter does: new leaves coming in smaller than the old ones, more bare stem between leaves, growth leaning hard toward the window, or nothing new at all through spring and summer. Those signs mean it has been too dark for a while, which is the argument for taking a reading before you place a plant rather than diagnosing one after. Can light be too bright for plants? Yes, and it is the failure people expect least. Direct midday sun through glass will scorch leaves on plants sold as “bright light”. Bright indirect and direct sun are not two points on one scale. A spot can be bright all day and still take almost no direct sun, and for most houseplants that is the spot you want. Do plants need direct sunlight, or is a bright room enough? Most common houseplants want bright indirect light: a spot that sees plenty of sky and little direct sun. “A bright room” is where it gets slippery: the room can feel bright while the spot you are eyeing, 2 m back and off to one side, sits at a small fraction of the window’s light. The six readings above are one example of exactly that. Can you use your phone as a light meter for plants? Yes — well enough to compare spots, not to quote three digits. Lay the phone face up where the plant would live; on iPhone, a sheet of white printer paper over the front camera is what makes it a measurement rather than an estimate. The checker above has no sensor; it estimates from the window direction you pick. Keep reading [How far from a window can a plant be?](/guides/howfarfromawindowcanplantslive/) [How to measure light for plants](/guides/howtomeasurelightforplants/) [Lowlight plants that actually survive](/guides/lowlightplantsthatsurvive/) [Northfacing window plants](/guides/northfacingwindowplants/) [Eastfacing window plants](/guides/eastfacingwindowplants/) [Southfacing window plants](/guides/southfacingwindowplants/) [Westfacing window plants](/guides/westfacingwindowplants/) [Dark corner plants](/guides/darkcornerplants/) [Plants for a room with no windows](/guides/plantsforaroomwithnowindows/) [All guides](/guides/) Put this checker on your own site Free, and you do not have to ask us. Paste this where you want it. It works on any page, keeps running on our servers rather than yours, and the two links underneath it are the whole price. <iframe src="https://growspotapp.com/embed/spotchecker/" title="GrowSpot plant spot checker" width="100%" height="440" loading="lazy" style="maxwidth:640px;border:1px solid dfe5df;borderradius:12px"</iframe <script addEventListener('message', function (e) { if (e.origin == 'https://growspotapp.com') return; var h = e.data && e.data.growspotHeight; if ((h 200 && h < 4000)) return; var f = document.querySelectorAll('iframe[src^="https://growspotapp.com/embed/spotchecker/"]'); fo
items.author: growspotapp
items.descZh: GrowSpot 是一款针对植物光照需求的免费网页工具，旨在解决“房间够不够亮”这个模糊问题。它指出同一房间的光照差异极大，从窗户附近的 20,000 lux 到暗角的 18 lux，相差上千倍，因此必须针对具体摆放点进行评估。核心功能是根据用户描述的窗户方向和植物种类，估算该位置的光照是否适宜，而非给出一个笼统的房间亮度判断。亮点在于提供了具体的 lux 数值作为参考，并强调光照只是温度、湿度和 airflow 四要素之一。该工具无需注册，同时提供移动端 App 可进行实地精准测量，且支持嵌入到其他网站。适用于植物爱好者在购买或移栽前，快速筛查室内潜在摆放点的光照条件。
items.quote: 这就是为什么“我的房间够亮吗”没有答案，而“这个点够亮吗”有答案。
items.titleZh: Show HN: GrowSpot – 检查植物是否能在某个精确位置（而非房间级别）存活

items.descZh: hibi 是一个开源的桌面端写作应用，旨在为用户提供一个统一的本地笔记与文档编辑环境。它支持 Markdown 语法书写，并提供源码编辑与实时预览的双视图并排显示模式，方便用户在不同编辑视角间切换。项目基于 Electron 构建，拥有完整的开发工具链，包括 Vitest 测试框架和 Biome 代码检查工具，当前在 GitHub 上获得 14 个星标，累计提交达 331 次，显示出活跃的社区参与度。该应用适合需要离线写作、注重隐私的开发者、技术写作者或追求高效本地工作流的创作者使用。
items.quote: 一个应用，搞定你写的一切

Ambits [](https://github.com/joshLong145/ambits/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](https://codecov.io/gh/joshLong145/ambits) A codereading tool for AI agents, and a memory of what they have read. Coding agents read whole files to find one function, reread code they already know, and lose all of it the moment the context window compacts. ambits addresses both halves of that: Reading — ambits show returns a symbol's definition as structured JSON, addressed by name or by content hash. The agent asks for App/process_compaction, not for 2,000 lines of app.rs. Remembering — ambits records every symbol the agent reads, at what depth, throughout the session. After a compaction it can hand that history back, so the agent knows what it already understands instead of rediscovering it. Both surfaces are plain text and JSON with no vendor coupling, so the record can be handed between agents, or between providers. Ingestion is currently built and tested against Claude Code. There is also a live TUI, for when you want to watch what your agent is actually looking at. [](/joshLong145/ambits/blob/main/images/screenshot.png) Quick start cargo install ambits Read a symbol instead of a file ambits p . show 'src/app.rs::App/process_compaction' What has this session read so far? ambits p . restorecontext Hand that history back automatically after every compaction ambits hook install project . Watch it live ambits p . For the agent Searching code A grep whose every hit knows which symbol it landed in. ambits p . rg 'is_binary' every use and definition ambits p . rg 'fn enclosing' t rust one file type ambits p . rg 'TODO' g 'tests/' globs; excludes ambits p . rg 'Journal::open' A 3 with trailing context ambits p . rg 'unwrap\(\)' c matching lines per file src/find.rs:67:7:[full BINARY_SNIFF_BYTES] const BINARY_SNIFF_BYTES: usize = 8 1024; src/find.rs:337:4:[full is_binary] fn is_binary(buf: &[u8]) bool { src/find.rs:338:21:[full is_binary] buf.iter().take(BINARY_SNIFF_BYTES).any(&b b == 0) src/find.rs:442:8:[full search_file] if is_binary(&buf) matcher.worth_searching(&buf) { file:line:column: — the prefix every grep consumer already parses — then the symbol the match sits in and how deeply this session has read it, then the line. nosymbol drops that field for output byteidentical to ripgrep's. Why two commands grep(1) and ripgrep assign opposite meanings to the same short flags, so no single command can be faithful to both: Flag GNU grep ripgrep \L \fileswithoutmatch \follow (symlinks) \z \nulldata \searchzip \r \recursive \replace \h \nofilename help ambits rg and ambits grep are two front ends over one engine — the same matcher, the same symbol attribution, the same output contract — each faithful to the tool it is named after. rg is the one to reach for: Claude Code's own Grep tool is ripgrepbacked, so it is the dialect agents already speak. ambits grep

items.descZh: ambits是一个针对AI代理的代码阅读工具，旨在解决代理在阅读代码时面临的挑战，如为了查找一个函数而读取整个文件、重复阅读已知代码，以及在上下文窗口压缩时丢失所有信息。其核心功能包括通过名称或内容哈希返回符号定义作为结构化JSON，以及记录会话中读取的符号历史，以便在压缩后恢复，避免重新发现已知内容。亮点在于代理可以请求特定符号如App/process_compaction，而不是加载整个2000行的app.rs文件，从而大幅减少token消耗；输出格式与ripgrep兼容，并提供实时TUI用于监控代理行为。该工具适用于AI编码代理在长时间开发会话中需要高效导航和记忆代码的场景，支持代理间共享记录。

agents an inmemory graph brain instead of making them guess from flat text. What is LAIN? LAIN is a persistent, highperformance code intelligence and coordination engine built specifically for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Agy, Cline, Windsurf, etc.) over the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of treating code as unstructured flat text or relying on fuzzy keyword searches, LAIN indexes your codebase into an inmemory, typed structural property graph (using Treesitter, language servers, and Git commit history). It then exposes a rich suite of deterministic MCP tools that allow AI agents to navigate, reason about, and modify complex codebases without hallucinations, blind edits, or contextwindow waste. items.author: spuentesp
items.descZh: LAIN 是一款专为 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等）设计的高性能、持久化代码智能与协同引擎，基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 协议构建。它彻底改变了传统 AI 处理代码的方式，不再将代码视为非结构化的纯文本或依赖模糊的关键字搜索，而是利用 Tree-sitter、语言服务器及 Git 历史将代码库索引为内存中的类型化结构化属性图。该引擎核心提供持久化知识图谱、爆炸半径分析和语义搜索等关键功能，基于 Rust 语言开发，具备极致的高性能与确定性。通过暴露一整套确定性的 MCP 工具，LAIN 赋予 AI 代理一个“图谱大脑”，使其能够无幻觉、无盲目编辑地导航、推理并修改复杂代码库，显著减少上下文窗口浪费。这使其非常适合需要多智能体协同、高精度代码分析与深度重构的现代企业级大型软件开发场景。
items.quote: 给你的编码智能体一个内存中的图谱大脑，而不是让它们去猜扁平文本。
